snippet.title: RUNT - Announcement Trailer (DEMO OUT NOW)
snippet.description:
RUNT is a rural gothic visual novel mystery where you play as Runt, the youngest of five brothers, surviving a monstrous post-apocalypse in the town of Skipclaw, cloaked in bleak darkness since the sky turned black ten years ago.

Try the Demo and wishlist now! https://dreadxp.games/RuntDemo

Follow the Devs: https://bsky.app/profile/grimtaste.bsky.social

Join the official DreadXP Discord: https://discord.gg/PX25QrbGrw
